svg.title: 2. AWS Platform & Request Flow
svg.text: One dedicated AWS account in us-east-1. Runtime is created only inside an approved window and is not live now; the foundation below it is retained on purpose.
Created and destroyed with its environment window. Exactly one NAT Gateway per
environment, in one Availability Zone: an accepted cost and egress-resilience
The architecture-baseline register, exactly. Every row is excluded from
Durable, but deliberately not members of the persistent-foundation register.

outside the customer VPC; API endpoint has both

authorized. RW-1 and RW-2 are closed.

Project, Environment, Component, Owner, ManagedBy, Lifecycle
ADR-0007 decides a managed internet-facing load-balancing boundary, public DNS and managed certificates without naming products. Route 53 and ACM are
the recorded implementation selection for the domain phase. No hosted zone, certificate or load balancer exists in Terraform today.
Request path: Client -> public DNS -> load-balancing boundary -> ingress and service boundary -> AstroShop
Egress path: private subnet pods -> single NAT Gateway -> Internet Gateway -> approved external destinations.
Object storage reaches S3 through the gateway endpoint instead.
Worker nodes never sit in a public subnet, and map_public_ip_on_launch is false on every subnet, public ones
